reading_note: Despite heavy lacunae, the arc is legible: hidden spiritual powers operating within the human form (the eye/senses standing for the receptive faculties of the natural mind) are described in their roots, their daily influx into the bodily ultimate, their immense number (myriads of seals = countless impressed truths; twenty myriads of archons = the corresponding host of falsities from evil), and then a discrimination process — what is genuine is chosen, purified, and drawn inward toward the Father through voice, speech and stillness of heart, while the archons belonging to Darkness are driven outward into Error. The single arc: separation within man between what ascends inward to the Lord and what is cast outward into falsity.
